paragraphs.text: Means get tended, the Lord does the tending, and the glory of release is what comes out. The stages of the world are certain, no doubt about it — and yet they are made up, put on like an actor puts on roles.

Vastness assumed shines bright; but where power tightens itself, things turn impure as they wander. The incomplete one confesses: defiled, stained — and still, underneath, all-pervading Lord. God does five acts; the self does the same five. The only difference between them is delusion.

Expansion gets sung as capable; contraction gets called wanderer. Maya wills only glimpses, and keeping and loosing get deemed as powers. Grace withdraws into oneness, and manifesting gets named as veiling. The present course is known like a jewel in the hand; ignorance beside it is timber, is clods.
